jobPostingInfo.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely. 

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We are currently seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join our rapidly growing engineering team. This role is for someone who is passionate about building innovative solutions and being exposed to new challenges and technologies while making an impact.

This role is available to candidates across Canada (excluding Quebec). If you are local to one of our hubs (Burnaby, Calgary, or Toronto) you will be expected to be in office minimum twice per week on one of our Anchor Days.

What your team does:

We at Clio have an amazing team that is on a mission to transform the legal experience for all, and our engineering team’s goal is to deliver an incredible experience to our customers. In the AI team in Clio, we use the latest technology in the space of NLP and GenAI to provide our customers with solutions to make their work more streamlined and efficient allowing them to have more time to focus on their clients’ needs.

A day in the life might look like:

  • Develop advanced machine learning models using structured and unstructured data to improve Clio’s customer’s experience

  • Create LLMs based solutions to help Clio’s clients to save time and create efficiencies

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product management, operations and data science to identify new ML-driven features for Clio customers

  • Work in an agile environment with our team of machine learning engineers, MLOps engineering and full stack developers across a variety of projects

What you may have:

  • Hands-on experience in model development, particularly with traditional machine learning, NLP, and transformer-based models;

  • Proficiency in data manipulation, cleaning, and preprocessing for complex unstructured datasets;

  • Experience with agentic frameworks and workflows 

  • Experience working with open-source LLM foundation models and APIs for commercial LLMs, such as ChatGPT or Gemini;

  • A proven ability to quickly learn new technologies and adapt to a dynamic, fast-paced environment with distributed teams and customers;

  • A portfolio of past projects showcasing your successes, challenges, and growth as a machine learning expert;

  • Exceptional communication skills and the ability to build trust with both internal teams and external customers;

  • A strong desire to continuously learn, challenge yourself, and refine your craft as a machine learning engineer.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

What you will find here:

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.
 

Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:

  • Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance 

  • Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin, London, New York City and Sydney) to be in office min. twice per week. 

  • Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.

  • $2000 annual counseling benefit

  • RRSP matching and RESP contribution 

  • Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years

The expected salary range for this role is $129,200 to $174,800 CAD. Initial placement within the range is informed by geographic region, experience, and skillset, with room to progress as impact and tenure grow. Final offer amounts will vary based on candidate profile.

jobPostingInfo.title: Senior AI Builder and Analyst, Customer Support
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely. 

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We are currently seeking a Senior AI Builder & Analyst to support our Customer Support organization. This role is available to candidates in our Burnaby, Calgary, or Toronto hub locations.

What your team does:

Customer Support, spanning Core Support, Technical Escalations, and Workforce Management, makes sure our people, tools, and processes are lined up to meet our customers where they are. As Clio moves further into an AI-first operating model, this role is where that shift is built: the tools, workflows, and collaboration that let a lean team see further and move faster across every function in Support.

This is a builder's role first. You're not just analyzing how AI could help; you're the one building and honing the tools that make it real, then handing off something the team can run.

What you'll work on:

  • Designing, building, and continuously refining AI-assisted tools and workflows for Support, Technical Escalations, and Workforce Management, closing the gap between "AI could help here" and a tool the team actually uses.

  • Owning the technical build: prompt design, workflow logic, integration with our existing stack, and ongoing tuning as needs change.

  • Partnering directly with leaders across Support, TechEsc, CSOps and WFM to identify where a built tool beats a manual process, and prioritizing accordingly; identifying where AI tooling should go next.

  • Optimizing and maintaining the AI-assisted QA tooling that turns conversation and case data into clear signal on quality and DSAT drivers, working closely with the QA program owner.

  • Designing dashboards and reporting that make quality trends visible to frontline leaders, not just to Support leadership.

  • Building and automating reporting on core Support metrics (SLA, occupancy, utilization, shrinkage, repeat contact) wherever a built tool beats a manual process, translating the data into recommendations leadership can act on.

  • Partnering with People/TAcq, Finance, and Product to keep the tools you build aligned to business growth and workforce planning needs.

What you bring:

  • 4+ years of experience working in a contact center or SaaS support environment.

  • Hands-on experience building AI-assisted workflows or tools, not just using them: prompt engineering, agentic workflows, AI QA scoring, or similar.

  • Strong reporting and data visualization skills (Looker, Salesforce, or advanced Excel/Sheets); comfort with SQL or a willingness to get there fast.

  • Working knowledge of core WFM and QA metrics (SLA, AHT, shrinkage, occupancy, utilization, DSAT, repeat contact) and what actually moves them.

  • A track record of translating complex, technical work into something a non-technical stakeholder can act on.

  • A bias for action and comfort operating without a lot of structure, this role is being built as the team's scope evolves, not stepping into something fully mapped out.

Serious bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with Talkdesk, Service Cloud, or a comparable contact center platform.

  • Exposure to building or evaluating AI teammates or agentic tooling in a live operational environment.

jobPostingInfo.title: Technical Trainer
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely. 

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

This role combines live technical training delivery with instructional design and e-learning development for Clio Operate customers. The Technical Trainer serves as a Clio Operate subject matter expert who assesses customer needs, delivers engaging live sessions, troubleshoots technical and configuration questions, and builds, maintains, and continuously improves self-paced Articulate Rise courses that scale training across the customer base.

Responsibilities

  • Assess customer technical environments and workflows to identify training needs, and recommend appropriate training solutions to enhance their practice management and productivity.

  • Conduct engaging and interactive training sessions for customers covering various aspects of Clio Operate.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert, providing guidance and best practices on utilizing Clio Operate to optimize workflows and productivity.

  • Troubleshoot technical and configuration questions that arise during training sessions, escalating complex issues to support or engineering as needed. 

  • Stay current on Clio Operate releases, features, and configuration options to ensure training content and delivery reflect the latest product capabilities.

  • Effectively communicate complex technical concepts and functionalities in a clear and concise manner, across both live and self-paced formats.

  • Design and build self-paced e-learning courses in Articulate Rise, applying instructional design principles — clear learning objectives, logical scaffolding, knowledge checks, and adult learning best practices.

  • Maintain and update existing Rise courses and other training content to reflect Clio Operate feature changes and new releases, ensuring materials remain accurate and current.

  • Build assessments and knowledge checks within courses to validate learner comprehension, and use LMS data (completion rates, quiz scores, engagement) to evaluate and improve training effectiveness.

  • Manage training content within the Learning Management System (LMS), including publishing, versioning, and reporting on usage and completion metrics.

  • Develop supporting learning assets — job aids, quick-reference guides, and storyboards — to reinforce and extend live training sessions.

  • Manage instructional design projects end-to-end, from scoping and storyboarding through stakeholder review and publishing.

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with customers, acting as a trusted advisor throughout their training and adoption journey while maintaining high standards of professionalism and customer service in all interactions.

  • Continuously evaluate and recommend improvements to training content based on customer feedback and learner outcome data.

  • Collaborate with product, support, and professional services teams to identify training gaps and translate them into new self-paced e-learning content.

  • Share insights and customer feedback to become an advocate for customers with internal stakeholders and contribute to product enhancements and improvements.

Additional Skills & Qualifications

  • Proven experience with Articulate Rise (or a comparable e-learning authoring tool such as Storyline) for building self-paced courses.

  • Instructional design experience — familiarity with ADDIE or similar frameworks, adult learning principles, and storyboarding.

  • Experience administering or publishing content within a Learning Management System (LMS).

  • Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to troubleshoot configuration and workflow questions within Clio Operate.

  • Strong live and virtual facilitation and presentation skills.

  • Working knowledge of Clio Operate or comparable legal practice management / matter management software, including configuration and administration.

  • Comfortable working with product documentation, release notes, and technical specifications to keep training content current.
